capabilities: edit a visual weekly timetable with periods, block types, A/B week rotation, and one-off events
create and manage dated lesson notes from built-in or custom templates
track directed-time hours against the STPCD 1,265-hour limit with an Excel report
export the timetable to Excel, CSV, or iCal for external calendars
run multiple planners with backups, imports, and reusable school templates
extras: Requires Obsidian v1.7.2 or later. Security section explains that Excel files are never parsed, only written.
motivation: If you have ever kept your timetable in one place, your lesson notes in another, and your hours in a spreadsheet, this brings all three together.
problem: Obsidian has no concept of school timetables, so teachers juggle separate tools for their schedule, lesson notes, and directed-time hours.

relations.evidence: Excel exports are generated with write-excel-file, a write-only library.

summary: Academic planner for teachers: visual timetable with A/B weeks, weekly lesson grid, templated lesson notes, directed-time tracking, and calendar export.
